description: The web guard on the legacy desktop, every section locked: viewer with the probe's Guest role. jfar-lock-allsettings hides the drawer's Settings link; the header's user button stays (the TV layout's only way to Sign out); the Settings menu page stays reachable with every section's link hidden, Sign out and the note "Settings are managed by your administrator" right above it, as text. Reads only.

steps.name: the guard has viewer's /Me (every section locked)
open the drawer
steps.script: const b = document.querySelector('.mainDrawerButton'); if (b) b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 900)); return !!b;

steps.name: the drawer's Settings link is hidden, the header's user button shown
steps.assert: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .btnSettings') || document.querySelector('a.navMenuOption[data-itemid="settings"]'); const u = document.querySelector('.skinHeader .headerUserButton'); return (!s || getComputedStyle(s).display === 'none') && !!u && getComputedStyle(u).display !== 'none'; })()

steps.name: open the Settings menu (the user button's target)
every section's link hidden; Sign out shown, the note right above it, as text
steps.assert: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#myPreferencesMenuPage:not(.hide)'); const links = ['.lnkUserProfile', '.lnkDisplayPreferences', '.lnkHomePreferences', '.lnkPlaybackPreferences', '.lnkSubtitlePreferences', '.lnkControlsPreferences', '.lnkQuickConnectPreferences'].map((s) => p.querySelector(s)).filter(Boolean); const out = p.querySelector('.btnLogout'); const note = p.querySelector('[data-jfar-note]'); return links.length >= 6 && links.every((l) => getComputedStyle(l).display === 'none') && getComputedStyle(out).display !== 'none' && note.nextElementSibling === out && note.textContent === 'Settings are managed by your administrator' && note.children.length === 0; })()

steps.name: the page stayed (the Settings menu is never redirected)
no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
